memoryBuilder.verseText: God said: 'I will fight for you. You can be still.'

sequence.prompt: How did God get His people through the sea? Put it in order.

items.label: The sea in front, the army behind
God sent a wind and the sea opened

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: God went in front of His people
There was nothing they could do

application.question: They could not save themselves at all. What feels too big for you to fix?
application.followUp: Not one of them rescued themselves — God did all of it, and then they sang. When you cannot fix it, stand still and let God fight for you.
